scope: Mathematical and source-backed cost/equivalence gate for opt-in day-partitioned covering series metadata (day, full stable ID, metric name, labels) for high-churn short-lived TimeSeries. Avoid packed/truncated IDs and full TAGS/TimeRanges scans without claiming native query speedup. Evaluate dedup across day boundaries, freshness and write/merge amplification. Does not change SAMPLES partitioning R15 or reuse R05 owned mark pruning.
reason: R15 native observed SAMPLES mark 13.65x reduction but only 1.226x whole query due 140000 unchanged metadata rows. A day covering index could reduce both tag/time metadata and samples reads for short-lived high-churn series.
